description:
Enable Developer Options on the device and check the current RAM usage of the Flight Crew View application. 

1. Enable Developer Options (go to Settings > About emulated device > tap Build number 7 times).
2. Navigate to System > Developer options > Running services.
3. Find 'Flight Crew View' in the list.
4. Read its memory usage (e.g., '45 MB').
5. Create a text file at '/sdcard/ram_audit.txt' containing just the memory value.
6. Take a screenshot of the Running services screen showing the app's entry and save it to '/sdcard/ram_evidence.png'.
